t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The Gnomes are shown on the screen in pairs; A tall blue gnome & a tall pink gnome, a tall purple and small yellow, a small green and small orange and a small red and tall brown. It has been recommended to me that in general the best sequence to follow is tall blue, tall purple, small orange, tall brown, I've been advised to stick with this sequence as often as possible however I may find as I progress the best option with switch so in that case choose the opposite sequence until the original one comes back into play

vb_textbox.text:
Two gnomes will be shown on the screen, I seemed to perform best when I picked the following; The tall blue gnome, the Tall purple, the tall brown and the short orange gnome. Doesn't work EVERY time but generally I felt this worked best. Remember BLUE  PURPLE  BROWN  ORANGE
also TAKE THE BREAKS, kind of fries your head a bit.
Good luck :)
